Blocking a customer propagates to the identity blocklist across licence number, ID number and Veriff document number
Veriff document_type is mapped by substring match to passport / license / id_card blocklist types
Every block/unblock writes a BLOCK_CUSTOMER / UNBLOCK_CUSTOMER audit_logs entry
Fix: app_users is keyed by auth_user_id, not user_id, so the caller lookup silently found nobody
Super admins (is_super_admin true / tenant_id NULL) bypass the tenant check in block and unblock
Throwaway debug_unblock_customer probe that dumps caller vs customer tenant state to diagnose the access-denied loop
Hypothesis in source: the caller may be operating from a different tenant subdomain than the customer's tenant, so the in-function tenant check kept refusing
Rationale: in-function tenant validation is removed entirely because RLS already enforces isolation - if you can read the customer, you may block them
Rationale: audit_logs really uses actor_id / entity_type / entity_id / details, not user_id / table_name / record_id / old_data / new_data - every earlier block-fix wrote to columns that do not exist
audit_logs.actor_id is the app_users row id, resolved from auth.uid(), not the auth user id itself
Re-blocking reactivates the previously soft-deleted blocked_identities row instead of inserting a new one
Rationale: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING silently no-ops when an is_active=false blocklist row already exists, so a re-blocked customer stayed unblocked
Gotcha: unblock deactivates every blocked_identities row matching the identifier across all tenants - the tenant_id filter was deliberately dropped
Regression risk: this file has the highest timestamp of the block/unblock series yet reinstates the pre-fix audit_logs columns and the tenant check that 100005-100007 removed
Original defect: unblock ignored the Veriff document_number, leaving a stale active blocklist row that kept the customer barred
Tenant head_admins and admins can list every user in their own tenant
Rationale: the policy on app_users must call SECURITY DEFINER helpers, because reading app_users inside its own policy triggers a recursive RLS check that made new users invisible in Manage Users
Duplicate migration: 120001 re-applies the identical app_users policy body one minute later
